entries.hades.saveEditor.readConfirm: Reading this source discards the current pending changes.

entries.hades.saveEditor.key: Typed JSON for the Lua Key
entries.hades.saveEditor.advancedWarning: Direct editing changes saved data. The native impact of unrecognized fields is unknown.
entries.hades.saveEditor.typedHelp: Use JSON preserving Lua types: luaType is nil, boolean, number, string or table. Tables retain arraySize, hashSize and entries containing key and value. Byte strings use encoding: base64; raw doubles use encoding: ieee754. Completed valid input enters Changes.
entries.hades.saveEditor.invalidValue: Invalid input. Correct the number or typed Lua JSON, then finish editing again.
entries.hades.saveEditor.invalidResponse: The editor response is incompatible. Read the source again; current changes remain available.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.ambiguousKey: Multiple physical entries share this Lua key. Select an occurrence in Advanced.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.aspectRequiresUnl: Unlock or rank this aspect before selecting it; its rank can be staged in the same batch.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.checksumMismatch: This Hades save file failed checksum verification.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.headerConflict: A staged header edit conflicts with the native cache or mode projection. Revise one action.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.invalidFormat: This save file does not match the supported Hades format.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.invalidMutation: This edit is not valid for the selected save field.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.invalidQuery: The Save Editor query or filter is invalid.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.invalidTypedValue: The value does not match a valid typed Lua value or path.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.noChanges: There are no staged changes to apply.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.notOpen: This editor workspace is closed. Reopen the selected document.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.operationFailed: The Save Editor could not complete this operation.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.overlappingAction: These staged actions overlap one physical owner. Revise or remove one action in Changes.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.ownerNotTable: A native save owner is not a Lua table. Repair its typed value in Advanced.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.requiresAdvanced: This field has no ordinary descriptor. Open its typed occurrence in Advanced.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.selectSource: Choose one Hades save file to open.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.staleBaseline: This control belongs to an earlier document baseline. Refresh the editor before editing.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.unavailable: Save management is unavailable for the Save Editor.
entries.hades.saveEditor.error.unsupportedVersio: This Hades save version is unsupported; version 16 is required.
entries.hades.saveEditor.recovery: This write retained recovery evidence. Preserve the copy below and inspect it through Save Management before recovery. Do not repeat this Apply.
entries.hades.saveEditor.hot: Disk replacement is verified. The running game has not reloaded this data; a later game save may overwrite it.
entries.hades.saveEditor.loadInGame: Load the target save in the game to use these changes.
entries.hades.fishing.title: Fishing Point
entries.hades.fishing.probabilityHelp: Controls the conditional Fishing Point chance for newly created rooms (0–100%). 100% still requires native room points, Rod of Fishing, progression and spacing; 0% suppresses ordinary rolls while preserving native forced spawns. Prepared rooms retain their captured roll.
entries.hades.fishingHelp: Generates once in an eligible room with a native fishing point. Fishing, catch records and turn-in follow the native flow.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.scene: Requires an actionable chamber in the current run.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.native: Native Fishing Point functions are unavailable in this game state.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.existing: A Fishing Point has already appeared, been used or been generated in this chamber.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.placement: This chamber has no unused native Fishing Point.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.rod: Requires unlocking the Rod of Fishing or a native forcing effect.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.spacing: Too few chambers have passed since the previous Fishing Point.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.progression: This chamber does not meet native Fishing Point eligibility requirements.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.room: This chamber has no eligible native fishing point, or one already appeared, was used or was generated.
entries.hades.chaosGate.title: Chaos Gate
entries.hades.chaosGate.probabilityHelp: Controls the conditional Chaos Gate chance for newly created rooms (0–100%). 100% still requires native room eligibility, SecretPoint, progression and spacing; 0% suppresses uncommitted occurrence, including an unconsumed Light of Ixion. Prepared rooms retain their captured roll.
entries.hades.chaosGateHelp: Generates once where native eligibility and entrance points permit it. Entry retains the native health cost and room flow.
entries.hades.chaosGate.unavailable.scene: Requires an actionable chamber in the current run.

entries.hades.chaosGate.unavailable.route: No eligible native Chaos destination and return path are available from this chamber.
entries.hades.chaosGate.unavailable.placement: This chamber has no native SecretPoint for a Chaos Gate.
entries.hades.chaosGate.unavailable.occupied: Every native SecretPoint in this chamber is already occupied by an Erebus Gate.
entries.hades.chaosGate.unavailable.room: Chaos Gates cannot naturally spawn in this chamber type without a native forcing effect.
entries.hades.chaosGate.unavailable.spacing: Too few chambers have passed since the previous Chaos Gate.
entries.hades.chaosGate.unavailable.progression: This chamber does not meet native Chaos Gate eligibility requirements.

entries.hades.forceEnableRerollsHelp: Enables rerolls on newly built boon, shop, purge menus and exits. Preserves blocked offers, costs and door eligibility without changing Mirror selections.
entries.hades.boonRarityHelp: New or rerolled Olympian and Hermes offers meet the selected minimum rarity and optionally force eligible Legendary or Duo boons while preserving higher native odds, prerequisites and Force Common. Chaos, Hammers and existing offers are unchanged.
